verses.en: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, ó Israel, ouve os estatutos e os preceitos que eu vos ensino, para os observardes, a fim de que vivais, e entreis e possuais a terra que o Senhor Deus de vossos pais vos dá.
verses.en_web: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances, which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.
verses.en_bbe: And now give ear, O Israel, to the laws and the decisions which I am teaching you, and do them; so that life may be yours, and you may go in and take for yourselves the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, is giving you.

verses.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.pt: Não acrescentareis à palavra que vos mando, nem diminuireis dela, para que guardeis os mandamentos do Senhor vosso Deus, que eu vos mando.
verses.en_web: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.
verses.en_bbe: Make no addition to the orders which I give you, and take nothing from them, but keep the orders of the Lord your God which I give you.

verses.en: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.pt: Os vossos olhos viram o que o Senhor fez por causa de Baal-Peor; pois a todo homem que seguiu a Baal-Peor, o Senhor vosso Deus o consumiu do meio de vós.
verses.en_web: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for all the men who followed Baal Peor, Yahweh your God has destroyed them from among you.
verses.en_bbe: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baal-peor: for destruction came from the Lord on all those among you who went after Baal-peor.

verses.en: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.pt: Mas vós, que vos apegastes ao Senhor vosso Deus, todos estais hoje vivos.
verses.en_web: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.
verses.en_bbe: But you who kept faith with the Lord are living, every one of you, today.

verses.en: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.pt: Eis que vos ensinei estatutos e preceitos, como o Senhor meu Deus me ordenou, para que os observeis no meio da terra na qual estais entrando para a possuirdes.
verses.en_web: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
verses.en_bbe: I have been teaching you laws and decisions, as I was ordered to do by the Lord my God, so that you might keep them in the land to which you are going to take it for your heritage.

verses.en: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.pt: Guardai-os e observai-os, porque isso é a vossa sabedoria e o vosso entendimento à vista dos povos, que ouvirão todos estes, estatutos, e dirão: Esta grande nação é deveras povo sábio e entendido.
verses.en_web: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
verses.en_bbe: So keep these laws and do them; for so will your wisdom and good sense be clear in the eyes of the peoples, who hearing all these laws will say, Truly, this great nation is a wise and far-seeing people.

verses.en: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
verses.pt: Pois que grande nação há que tenha deuses tão chegados a si como o é a nós o Senhor nosso Deus todas as vezes que o invocamos?
verses.en_web: For what great nation is there, that has a god so near to them, as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?
verses.en_bbe: For what great nation has a god so near to them as the Lord our God is, whenever we are turned to him in prayer?

verses.en: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.pt: E que grande nação há que tenha estatutos e preceitos tão justos como toda esta lei que hoje ponho perante vós?
verses.en_web: What great nation is there, that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you today?
verses.en_bbe: And what great nation has laws and decisions so right as all this law which I put before you today?

verses.en: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;
verses.pt: Tão-somente guarda-te a ti mesmo, e guarda bem a tua alma, para que não te esqueças das coisas que os teus olhos viram, e que elas não se apaguem do teu coração todos os dias da tua vida; porém as contarás a teus filhos, e aos filhos de teus filhos;
verses.en_web: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children;
verses.en_bbe: Only take care, and keep watch on your soul, for fear that the things which your eyes have seen go from your memory and from your heart all the days of your life; but let the knowledge of them be given to your children and to your children's children;

verses.en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.pt: o dia em que estiveste perante o Senhor teu Deus em Horebe, quando o Senhor me disse: Ajunta-me este povo, e os farei ouvir as minhas palavras, e aprendê-las-ão, para me temerem todos os dias que na terra viverem, e as ensinarão a seus filhos.
verses.en_web: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
verses.en_bbe: That day when you were waiting before the Lord your God in Horeb, and the Lord said to me, Make all the people come together, so that hearing my words they may go in fear of me all the days of their life on earth and give this teaching to their children.

verses.en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.pt: Então vós vos chegastes, e vos pusestes ao pé do monte; e o monte ardia em fogo até o meio do céu, e havia trevas, e nuvens e escuridão.
verses.en_web: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
verses.en_bbe: And you came near, waiting at the foot of the mountain; and flames of fire went up from the mountain to the heart of heaven, with dark clouds, and all was black as night.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
verses.pt: E o Senhor vos falou do meio do fogo; ouvistes o som de palavras, mas não vistes forma alguma; tão-somente ouvistes uma voz.
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
verses.en_bbe: And the voice of the Lord came to you out of the fire: the sound of his words came to your ears but you saw no form; there was nothing but a voice.

verses.en: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.pt: Então ele vos anunciou o seu pacto, o qual vos ordenou que observásseis, isto é, os dez mandamentos; e os escreveu em duas tábuas de pedra.
verses.en_web: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave you his agreement with you, the ten rules which you were to keep, which he put in writing on the two stones of the law.

verses.en: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.pt: Também o Senhor me ordenou ao mesmo tempo que vos ensinasse estatutos e preceitos, para que os cumprísseis na terra a que estais passando para a possuirdes.
verses.en_web: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord gave me orders at that time to make clear to you these laws and decisions, so that you might do them in the land to which you are going, and which is to be your heritage.

verses.en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.pt: Guardai, pois, com diligência as vossas almas, porque não vistes forma alguma no dia em que o Senhor vosso Deus, em Horebe, falou convosco do meio do fogo;
verses.en_web: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
verses.en_bbe: So keep watch on yourselves with care; for you saw no form of any sort on the day when the voice of the Lord came to you in Horeb out of the heart of the fire:

verses.en: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.pt: para que não vos corrompais, fazendo para vós alguma imagem esculpida, na forma de qualquer figura, semelhança de homem ou de mulher;
verses.en_web: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.en_bbe: So that you may not be turned to evil ways and make for yourselves an image in the form of any living thing, male or female,

verses.en: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.pt: ou semelhança de qualquer animal que há na terra, ou de qualquer ave que voa pelo céu;
verses.en_web: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
verses.en_bbe: Or any beast of the earth, or winged bird of the air,

verses.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.pt: ou semelhança de qualquer animal que se arrasta sobre a terra, ou de qualquer peixe que há nas águas debaixo da terra;
verses.en_web: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
verses.en_bbe: Or of anything which goes flat on the earth, or any fish in the water under the earth.

verses.en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.pt: e para que não suceda que, levantando os olhos para o céu, e vendo o sol, a lua e as estrelas, todo esse exército do céu, sejais levados a vos inclinardes perante eles, prestando culto a essas coisas que o Senhor vosso Deus repartiu a todos os povos debaixo de todo o céu.
verses.en_web: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
verses.en_bbe: And when your eyes are lifted up to heaven, and you see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the army of heaven, do not let yourselves be moved to give them worship, or become the servants of what the Lord has given equally to all peoples under heaven.

verses.en: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
verses.pt: Mas o Senhor vos tomou, e vos tirou da fornalha de ferro do Egito, a fim de lhe serdes um povo hereditário, como hoje o sois.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord has taken you out of the flaming fire, out of Egypt, to be to him the people of his heritage, as you are today.

verses.en: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
verses.pt: O Senhor se indignou contra mim por vossa causa, e jurou que eu não passaria o Jordão, e que não entraria na boa terra que o Senhor vosso Deus vos dá por herança;
verses.en_web: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land, which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord was angry with me because of you, and made an oath that I was not to go over Jordan into the good land which the Lord is giving you for your heritage:

verses.en: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.pt: mas eu tenho de morrer nesta terra; não poderei passar o Jordão; porém vós o passareis, e possuireis essa boa terra.
verses.en_web: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan; but you shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.en_bbe: But death is to come to me in this land, I may not go over Jordan: but you will go over and take that good land for your heritage.

verses.en: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.pt: Guardai-vos de que vos esqueçais do pacto do Senhor vosso Deus, que ele fez convosco, e não façais para vós nenhuma imagem esculpida, semelhança de alguma coisa que o Senhor vosso Deus vos proibiu.
verses.en_web: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.
verses.en_bbe: Take care that you do not let the agreement of the Lord your God, which he has made with you, go out of your mind, or make for yourselves images of any sort, against the orders which the Lord your God has given you.

verses.en: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor vosso Deus é um fogo consumidor, um Deus zeloso.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord your God is an all-burning fire, and he will not let the honour which is his be given to any other.

verses.en: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.pt: Quando, pois, tiverdes filhos, e filhos de filhos, e envelhecerdes na terra, e vos corromperdes, fazendo alguma imagem esculpida, semelhança de alguma coisa, e praticando o que é mau aos olhos do Senhor vosso Deus, para o provocar a ira, -
verses.en_web: When you shall father children, and children’s children, and you shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight, to provoke him to anger;
verses.en_bbe: If, when you have had children and children's children, and have been living a long time in the land, you are turned to evil ways, and make an image of any sort, and do evil in the eyes of the Lord your God, moving him to wrath:

verses.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.pt: hoje tomo por testemunhas contra vós o céu e a terra, - bem cedo perecereis da terra que, passado o Jordão, ides possuir. Não prolongareis os vossos dias nela, antes sereis de todo destruídos.
verses.en_web: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
verses.en_bbe: May heaven and earth be my witnesses against you today, that destruction will quickly overtake you, cutting you off from that land which you are going over Jordan to take; your days will not be long in that land, but you will come to a complete end.

verses.en: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
verses.pt: E o Senhor vos espalhará entre os povos, e ficareis poucos em número entre as nações para as quais o Senhor vos conduzirá.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations, where Yahweh will lead you away.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord will send you wandering among the peoples; only a small band of you will be kept from death among the nations where the Lord will send you.

verses.en: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.pt: Lá servireis a deuses que são obra de mãos de homens, madeira e pedra, que não vêem, nem ouvem, nem comem, nem cheiram.
verses.en_web: There you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.en_bbe: There you will be the servants of gods, made by men's hands, of wood and stone, having no power of seeing or hearing or taking food or smelling.

verses.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.pt: Mas de lá buscarás ao Senhor teu Deus, e o acharás, quando o buscares de todo o teu coração e de toda a tua alma.
verses.en_web: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you shall find him, when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.en_bbe: But if in those lands you are turned again to the Lord your God, searching for him with all your heart and soul, he will not keep himself from you.

verses.en: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.pt: Quando estiveres em angústia, e todas estas coisas te alcançarem, então nos últimos dias voltarás para o Senhor teu Deus, e ouvirás a sua voz;
verses.en_web: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God, and listen to his voice.
verses.en_bbe: When you are in trouble and all these things have come on you, if, in the future, you are turned again to the Lord your God, and give ear to his voice:

verses.en: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.pt: porquanto o Senhor teu Deus é Deus misericordioso, e não te desamparará, nem te destruirá, nem se esquecerá do pacto que jurou a teus pais.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you, neither destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
verses.en_bbe: Because the Lord your God is a God of mercy, he will not take away his help from you or let destruction overtake you, or be false to the agreement which he made by an oath with your fathers.

verses.en: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
verses.pt: Agora, pois, pergunta aos tempos passados que te precederam desde o dia em que Deus criou o homem sobre a terra, desde uma extremidade do céu até a outra, se aconteceu jamais coisa tão grande como esta, ou se jamais se ouviu coisa semelhante?
verses.en_web: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as this great thing is, or has been heard like it?
verses.en_bbe: Give thought now to the days which are past, before your time, from the day when God first gave life to man on the earth, and searching from one end of heaven to the other, see if such a great thing as this has ever been, or if anything like it has been talked of in story.

verses.en: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.pt: Ou se algum povo ouviu a voz de Deus falar do meio do fogo, como tu a ouviste, e ainda ficou vivo?
verses.en_web: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
verses.en_bbe: Has any people ever gone on living after hearing the voice of God out of the heart of the fire as you did?

verses.en: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.pt: Ou se Deus intentou ir tomar para si uma nação do meio de outra nação, por meio de provas, de sinais, de maravilhas, de peleja, de mão poderosa, de braço estendido, bem como de grandes espantos, segundo tudo quanto fez a teu favor o Senhor teu Deus, no Egito, diante dos teus olhos?
verses.en_web: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.en_bbe: Has God ever before taken a nation for himself from out of another nation, by punishments and signs and wonders, by war and by a strong hand and a stretched-out arm and great acts of wonder and fear, as the Lord your God did for you in Egypt, before your very eyes?

verses.en: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
verses.pt: A ti te foi mostrado para que soubesses que o Senhor é Deus; nenhum outro há senão ele.
verses.en_web: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.
verses.en_bbe: All this he let you see, so that you might be certain that the Lord is God and there is no other.

verses.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.pt: Do céu te fez ouvir a sua voz, para te instruir, e sobre a terra te mostrou o seu grande fogo, do meio do qual ouviste as suas palavras.
verses.en_web: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
verses.en_bbe: Out of heaven itself his voice came to you, teaching you; and on earth he let you see his great fire; and his words came to your ears out of the heart of the fire.

verses.en: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.pt: E, porquanto amou a teus pais, não somente escolheu a sua descendência depois deles, mas também te tirou do Egito com a sua presença e com a sua grande força;
verses.en_web: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
verses.en_bbe: And because of his love for your fathers, he took their seed and made it his, and he himself, present among you, took you out of Egypt by his great power;

verses.en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.pt: para desapossar de diante de ti nações maiores e mais poderosas do que tu, para te introduzir na sua terra e ta dar por herança, como neste dia se vê.
verses.en_web: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
verses.en_bbe: Driving out before you nations greater and stronger than you, to take you into their land and give it to you for your heritage, as at this day.

verses.en: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
verses.pt: Pelo que hoje deves saber e considerar no teu coração que só o Senhor é Deus, em cima no céu e embaixo na terra; não há nenhum outro.
verses.en_web: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
verses.en_bbe: So today be certain, and keep the knowledge deep in your hearts, that the Lord is God, in heaven on high and here on earth; there is no other God.

verses.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.pt: E guardarás os seus estatutos e os seus mandamentos, que eu te ordeno hoje, para que te vá bem a ti, e a teus filhos depois de ti, e para que prolongues os dias na terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dá, para todo o sempre.
verses.en_web: You shall keep his statutes, and his commandments, which I command you today, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land, which Yahweh your God gives you, forever.
verses.en_bbe: Then keep his laws and his orders which I give you today, so that it may be well for you and for your children after you, and that your lives may be long in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for ever.

verses.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.pt: Então Moisés separou três cidades além do Jordão, para o nascente,
verses.en_web: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses had three towns marked out on the far side of Jordan looking to the east;

verses.en: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.pt: para que se refugiasse ali o homicida que involuntariamente tivesse matado o seu próximo a quem dantes não tivesse ódio algum; para que, refugiando-se numa destas cidades, vivesse:
verses.en_web: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unawares, and didn’t hate him in time past; and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
verses.en_bbe: To which anyone causing the death of his neighbour in error and not through hate, might go in flight; so that in one of these towns he might be kept from death:

verses.en: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.pt: a Bezer, no deserto, no planalto, para os rubenitas; a Ramote, em Gileade, para os paditas; e a Golã, em Basã, para os manassitas.
verses.en_web: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
verses.en_bbe: The names of the towns were Bezer in the waste land, in the table-land, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for Manasseh.

verses.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.pt: Esta é a lei que Moisés propôs aos filhos de Israel;
verses.en_web: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: This is the law which Moses put before the children of Israel:

verses.en: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
verses.pt: estes são os testemunhos, os estatutos e os preceitos que Moisés falou aos filhos de Israel, depois que saíram do Egito,
verses.en_web: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Moses spoke to the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt,
verses.en_bbe: These are the rules and the laws and the decisions which Moses gave to the children of Israel after they came out of Egypt;

verses.en: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.pt: além do Jordão, no vale defronte de Bete-Peor, na terra de Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, a quem Moisés e os filhos de Israel derrotaram, depois que saíram do Egito;
verses.en_web: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: On the far side of Jordan, in the valley facing Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel overcame after they had come out of Egypt:

verses.en: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.pt: pois tomaram a terra deles em possessão, como também a terra de Ogue, rei de Basã, sendo esses os dois reis dos amorreus, que estavam além do Jordão, para o nascente;
verses.en_web: They took his land in possession, and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
verses.en_bbe: And they took his land for a heritage, and the land of Og, king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, whose lands were on the other side of Jordan to the east;

verses.en: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
verses.pt: desde Aroer, que está à borda do ribeiro de Arnom, até o monte de Siom, que é Hermom,
verses.en_web: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Sion (also called Hermon),
verses.en_bbe: From Aroer on the edge of the valley of the Arnon as far as Mount Sion, which is Hermon,

verses.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
verses.pt: e toda a Arabá, além do Jordão, para o oriente, até o mar da Arabá, pelas faldas de Pisga.
verses.en_web: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.en_bbe: And all the Arabah on the far side of Jordan to the east, as far as the sea of the Arabah under the slopes of Pisgah.
